nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Query 1688 product bestseller billboard data for sourcing discovery and wholesale product research. Trigger when the user mentions 1688 product rankings, 1688 bestseller lists, wholesale hot products, domestic sourcing rankings, dropshipping product selection, 1688 trending products, bulk purchase popular items, supplier product rankings, 1688 billboard, 1688 bestsellers, sourcing rankings, wholesale hot products, trending product rankings, supplier rankings, 1688 trends. Even if the user does not explicitly mention "1688 billboard", if their need involves discovering hot-selling wholesale products or sourcing opportunities on the 1688 platform, this skill should also be triggered.

buyerProtections.description: Buyer protections, comma-separated: free shipping, 7-day free return, or shipping insurance

companyType.description: Company type: 0 = no limit, 1 = store, 2 = factory

date.description: Query time. Weekly chart: pass the Sunday date of that week, e.g. 2025-06-15 (up to 90 days); Monthly chart: pass the first day of the month, e.g. 2025-06-01 (up to one year)

keyWord.description: Product search keyword (must be written in Simplified Chinese; translate it before calling this API). Maximum 50 characters

offerType.description: Product tag: 0 = no limit, 2 = new product, 3 = 1688 Select, 4 = cross-border, 5 = customization supported, 6 = store highlight. Default 0

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (10-100), default 20

productIds.description: Product IDs, separated by Chinese comma for multiple, max 20

proxyRights.description: Dropship rights (multi-select), comma-separated. Options: 4360897 (one-piece dropship with free shipping), 449154 (procure now, pay later)

searchType.description: Product keyword search type: 1 = fuzzy match, 3 = exact match. Default 1

sendTime.description: Delivery time (multi-select), comma-separated. Options: 24 (24 hours), 48 (48 hours), 72 (72 hours)

shiLiType.description: Seller membership type (multi-select), comma-separated. Options: superFactory (Super Factory), Power (Power Seller), TrustPass (TrustPass member only)

shopService.description: Seller services (multi-select), comma-separated. Options: 4057409 (Safe Buy), 888777 (Deep Verification Report)

sortField.description: Sort field, default orderCount. Options: orderCount (order count), saleCount (units sold), saleVolume (estimated sales amount), offerCreateTime (listing time), price (wholesale price), consignPrice (dropship price)

sortType.description: Sort order: desc (descending), asc (ascending), default desc

name: nexscope_1688_product_billboard
title: 1688 Product Billboard
